descFull: An MCP Server for Android running on the phone, optmized for token usage, supports also files downloads, camera, a privacy mode (to anonymize/pseudononymize your PII) and support various tunnelling (included a free E2E HTTPS tunnel out of the box in addition to cloudflare and ngrok).
